description: Kit Issue's curated menu -- decided 2026-09-09: same real SF2E rules and the same 150cr budget, no further restriction on what a player picks within it. Every item is a real SF2E "Commercial"-tier item (the game's own everyday civilian-grade equipment band, verified live against the Foundry equipment compendium), reflavoured as boring, standard, Directorate-issue. As players later acquire non-catalogue gear through the quartermaster (from Episode Two onward), that's the point where equipment starts saying something about a character beyond their assigned first role.

budget.source: Player Core pg. 23, Step 8: Buy Equipment

items.name: Directorate Sidearm, Pattern 3-A
items.flavorNote: Standard issue since before anyone currently serving joined. Nobody has ever asked to see the manual.

items.name: Directorate Long Arm, Pattern 3-B
items.flavorNote: The requisition slip calls it a "beam-emission rifle, civilian-rated." Everyone just calls it the long arm.

items.name: Directorate Close-Pattern Arm, Pattern 3-C
items.flavorNote: Marked for corridor and stairwell work on the requisition form, in exactly those words.

items.name: Directorate Edge Tool, Pattern 2
items.flavorNote: Filed as a multipurpose maintenance blade. It is also, unambiguously, a weapon, and the form doesn't pretend otherwise for long.

items.name: Directorate Undersuit, Pattern 4
items.mechanics: Light armor, +1 item bonus to AC, low bulk.
items.flavorNote: Worn under the uniform, not instead of it. Barely reads as armor until you need it to.

items.name: Directorate Field Plate, Pattern 6
items.mechanics: Medium armor, +3 item bonus to AC.
items.flavorNote: Heavier, hotter, and nobody has ever complained about it in a report that also mentions surviving something.

items.name: Directorate Comm Set, Standard
items.mechanics: Short/long-range voice communication with other comm units and Directorate channels.
items.flavorNote: Six-digit call sign, reassigned every intake so nobody keeps the same one twice.

items.name: Directorate Handlamp, Pattern 1
items.mechanics: Provides bright light in a cone.
items.flavorNote: The cheapest thing on the whole form, and the item most likely to actually matter tonight.

items.name: Directorate Line, 50 ft
items.flavorNote: Nobu signs off on this one without looking up. Everyone takes it eventually.

items.name: Directorate Maintenance Kit, Standard
items.flavorNote: Structural Command kids are handed this before they've finished asking for it.

items.name: Directorate Systems Kit, Standard
items.mechanics: Required to attempt Computers hacking actions.
items.flavorNote: Sensor Operator kids get a knowing look along with this one, and no explanation.

items.name: Directorate Ascent Kit, Standard
items.mechanics: Circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Climb.
items.flavorNote: Rated for a person, not a Frame. Somebody always asks anyway.

items.name: Directorate Field Kit, Standard
items.mechanics: Everything needed to make and break camp.
items.flavorNote: Nobody in this campaign has camped anywhere yet. Nobu issues it regardless.

items.name: Directorate Field Dressing, Aerosol
items.mechanics: Consumable, restores Hit Points on application.
items.flavorNote: The label lists side effects nobody reads and everybody should.

items.name: Directorate Trauma Patch, Standard
items.mechanics: Consumable, supports Medicine checks to Treat Wounds.
items.flavorNote: Shucks signs a chit for these personally. He notices who takes extra.
